primary_source_screen.finding: Daily par yield curve observations for 20 November; market close evidence for the Treasury rally.

primary_source_screen.institution: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)
primary_source_screen.finding: US high-yield option-adjusted spread reached 3.52% on 19 November; no same-day 20 November observation was available at cutoff.
Financial Stability Review discusses non-bank liquidity, repo and private-credit vulnerabilities; treated as institutional risk assessment, not proof of realized losses.
Third-quarter GDP advance estimate used to distinguish current activity from market repricing.

primary_source_screen.institution: National Bureau of Statistics of China
primary_source_screen.finding: October industrial production, retail and fixed-investment data show divergence between production and domestic demand.
October national CPI release used for Japan's inflation context.
October retail-sales release; observed activity, not a forecast.

As of 17 November, 11,613 confirmed Bundibugyo cases and 5,678 deaths across 68 health zones in eight DRC provinces; active transmission in 48 health zones; 81% average daily contact follow-up versus 95% target.

primary_source_screen.institution: Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention
primary_source_screen.finding: Six-month report: 1,146 of 10,659 confirmed cases with onset from weeks 19–45 (11%) came from existing contact lists; data cutoff differs from WHO's daily contact-follow-up measure.
South Sudan readiness self-assessment increased from 29% in May to 72.5% in October; this is readiness scoring, not proof of successful containment.
Attributed account of community deaths, insecurity, health-facility attacks, lost contacts and delayed frontline payments; not independent event verification.
All eight transmission lots were awarded; ANEEL reports R$8.8bn investment, 1,866 km of lines, 12,694 MVA of transformation capacity and a 50.10% discount against the RAP ceiling.

primary_source_screen.institution: Ministry of Mines and Energy of Brazil
primary_source_screen.finding: MME reports the same auction as R$8.9bn; retained as an official rounding difference, not added to ANEEL's R$8.8bn figure.
US crude, gasoline and distillate inventories for the week ended 13 November; US-only stock data, not a global supply balance.

event_reporting_screen.finding: Tanker reportedly struck by unidentified projectile near Khasab; no injuries reported, environmental impact unknown, vessel and actor not identified.

event_reporting_screen.institution: Reuters citing INA and Iraqi security officials
event_reporting_screen.finding: Fire halted Hartha power-station operations; plant had been operating at about 400 MW of 800 MW installed before the fire; cause and damage extent not established.

additional_thematic_article.title: Response capacity has expanded, but access to communities remains the binding constraint
additional_thematic_article.rationale: Already present in HEAD as the single thematic addition for 21 November; WHO's 20 November update and Africa CDC's six-month report provide a substantive epidemiological and operational delta. No duplicate or second thematic article was created.

decision: The 21 November Global Macro is pending revision 2. One thematic item (Bundibugyo response) is already pending in HEAD; no additional article is justified.
limitations: The 63-asset registry review is an operational coverage reconciliation, not exhaustive primary-source investigation of every line. Claims attributed to WHO, Africa CDC, Reuters, UKMTO, INA and security officials retain their source and verification limits.
